description: This file defines a generic command class `ScenarioCommand<T>` for executing load generator scenarios within a distributed testing framework, along with a static factory method for creating such commands. It sets up command-line options for client and load generator parameters and ties the command handler to a runner that executes the scenario.

classes.name: ScenarioCommand<T>
classes.description: A command class for executing a load generator scenario with specified options and handler.

methods.name: ScenarioCommand
methods.description: Constructor that sets up command options and ties the handler to the scenario runner.

methods.name: CreateCommand
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of ScenarioCommand for a given scenario and logger factory.
